name: com.katout.flowtask.testing
description: Engine-free testing for FlowTask: TestWorld, virtual time (TickFrames, TickFor, RunUntilComplete), scope tree assertions and the determinism probe. Reference the FlowTask.Testing assembly from a test assembly; it compiles only where tests are included (UNITY_INCLUDE_TESTS). List the package in the project's "testables" (Packages/manifest.json); otherwise Unity does not compile it (see https://katout.github.io/FlowTask/en/tools/testing/).
